title: Concealing it from the skilled observer
literal_meaning: Like hiding one’s belly from the midwife.
explanation: The example follows the definition of a skilled midwife. Our reading takes the contrast as attempted concealment from someone familiar with the matter. It is an analogy about expertise, not proof that any practitioner knows everything or a demand to disclose intimate information.
meaning_odia: ଦକ୍ଷ ପ୍ରସବସହାୟିକାର ସଂଜ୍ଞା ପରେ ଏହି ତୁଳନା ଆସିଛି। ଆମ ପାଠରେ, ଯିଏ ବିଷୟଟି ଜାଣନ୍ତି ତାଙ୍କଠାରୁ ସେହି କଥା ଲୁଚାଇବାର ଚେଷ୍ଟା ଏଠି ଦିଶେ। ଏହା ଦକ୍ଷତାକୁ ନେଇ ଉପମା; କେହି ସବୁ ଜାଣନ୍ତି ବା ନିଜର ଗୋପନ କଥା କହିବାକୁ ବାଧ୍ୟ ବୋଲି ନିୟମ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: Our reading concerns attempted concealment from someone with relevant experience.
odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ସମ୍ପୃକ୍ତ ଅଭିଜ୍ଞତା ଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କଠାରୁ କଥା ଲୁଚାଇବାର ଚେଷ୍ଟାକୁ ଦେଖେ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ଭଙ୍ଗା କବାଟର ଖରାପ କବଜାଟିକୁ ରଙ୍ଗରେ ଢାଙ୍କିଦିଆଗଲା। ମରାମତି କାରିଗର କବାଟ ଖୋଲି ସେହି ତ୍ରୁଟି ଦେଖିଲେ। / A repairer notices a faulty hinge beneath fresh paint. This invented analogy is not a medical encounter.
cultural_context: The source labels this a Dhaga comparison under midwife, distinct from the earlier wet-nurse sense. No diagnosis, historical incident or customary disclosure rule is established.
